title: Chat connections
webOnly: Manage chat connections on the web server.
empty: Bring the Agent to your chat app
emptyHelp: Create a Telegram bot or a Feishu app, choose the servers it may access, then bind your account with a one-time code.

setupHelp.telegram: Receives private messages through Telegram Bot API long polling; no public callback URL is needed. The server must reach Telegram.
setupHelp.feishu: Receives private messages through a Feishu long connection; no public callback URL is needed. The server must reach open.feishu.cn.

name: Connection name
keepToken: Leave blank to keep the current token
tokenHelp: Credentials are encrypted and never returned to the browser. Create a dedicated bot with Telegram BotFather.
serversHelp: Only the selected servers are accessible, up to 100. Bound accounts inherit this scope.
noServers: Add a server in the console first.
editStopsWork: Saving configuration stops existing tasks and invalidates pending approval buttons.
deleteConfirm: Deleting this connection stops its tasks and removes bindings and delivery records. Agent conversation history is retained.
bindingHelp: The binding code is valid for 10 minutes and works once; generating a new one invalidates the old. Whoever holds the code gets this connection's server access, so only use it in your own private chat with the bot.
codeExpired: This binding code has expired. Create a new one.
revokeConfirm: Revoking this account stops its tasks, invalidates unused approvals, and discards pending replies to this account.

modeHelp.readonly: Read server information, monitoring data and files. Shell commands and write operations are disabled.
modeHelp.balanced: Queries are allowed. Commands and file changes use the existing Agent approval flow.

noSessions: No sessions yet. After binding an account, message the bot in the chat app to start.
selectSession: Select a session to see the bot's conversation in the chat app.
transcriptHint: Rebuilt from what the bot sent; instant acknowledgements are omitted
keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the current App Secret
feishuHelp: Create a custom app on the Feishu Open Platform with the bot capability. Under events and callbacks choose long connection, subscribe to message receive (im.message.receive_v1) and card action (card.action.trigger), publish a version, then enter the App ID and App Secret. Credentials are stored encrypted and never returned to the browser.
feishuBindHint: Open the bot's private chat and send the command above to bind.
